actions.name: curve right on the floor (left 40 %, right 10 %)

control_flow: followInTheDark checks RLIGHT below 60 %; if not, it calls avoidWalls.
If RLIGHT is below 60 %, it checks LLIGHT below 45 %, then line tracker brightness above 95 %, otherwise it calls avoidWalls.
avoidWalls checks LLIGHT below 70 %, then the LEFT and RIGHT obstacle sensors, otherwise it calls driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark checks LLIGHT below 70 %: if yes it drives forward, otherwise it calls stopAtWall.
stopAtWall checks the FRONT obstacle sensor: if yes it stops, otherwise it calls followLine.
followLine curves left when the line tracker sees black, otherwise it curves right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, including when the robot drives into a dim tunnel.

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60 %: it checks LLIGHT and the line tracker
the right light is 60 % or more: it calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: inside the dim-light branch: first LLIGHT below 45 %, second line tracker brightness above 95 %

branches.outcome: LLIGHT is below 45 %: it curves left
LLIGHT is not below 45 % and the line tracker reads above 95 %: it curves right
LLIGHT is below 70 %: it checks the side obstacle sensors
LLIGHT is 70 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: inside the dim-light wall check: first a wall in front of the LEFT sensor, second in front of the RIGHT sensor

branches.outcome: LEFT sees a wall: it turns right by 20°
LEFT does not see it and RIGHT does: it turns left by 20°
neither side sees a wall: it calls driveInTheDark
LLIGHT is below 70 %: it drives forward
LLIGHT is 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: the FRONT obstacle sensor sees something

branches.outcome: FRONT sees a wall: it stops
FRONT sees nothing: it calls followLine
